result.summary: The pedestrian environment features narrow sidewalks and a marked but faded crosswalk at an intersection. Significant visual obstructions are present due to a large delivery vehicle parked near the corner and a building that creates a blind corner for a garage exit.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A large delivery van is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, completely blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, near the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: Garage Conflict Point
hazards.description: A garage entrance/exit crosses the sidewalk, creating a potential conflict zone where drivers may not see pedestrians when exiting.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, integrated into the modern grey building.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground on the roadway surface.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Replace the faded parallel line markings with high-visibility continental (ladder) markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

result.summary: The intersection features a mixed-use environment with a bakery and residential units, but lacks robust pedestrian infrastructure. Faded crosswalks, poor pavement quality, and a lack of visible traffic controls or curb ramps create a challenging environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing visibility for drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the side street

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A black SUV is parked very close to the intersection corner, blocking the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the roadway and near the crossing area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps at the crossing point, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with continental or ladder markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Traffic Control Installation
interventions.description: Install stop signs or a mini-roundabout to manage traffic flow and speed at the intersection.

result.summary: The environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks adjacent to mixed-use developments, providing a good walking surface. However, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks and curb ramps, and the roadway pavement is significantly degraded with visible cracks and patches.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the intersection, which may lead to confusion between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and uneven, posing a potential trip hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection limit visibility for both pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distances and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded asphalt to provide a smooth and safe crossing surface for all users.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow, one-way urban street with a modern mixed-use building and a well-maintained sidewalk. While the low-traffic nature and presence of tactile paving are positive, the lack of marked crosswalks and sightline obstructions from parked cars reduce pedestrian safety.
